name: CCI Group, Inc.
summary: CCI Group, Inc. operates as a holding company for The Hokkoku Bank,Ltd. that provides various financial services in Japan. It operates through the Banking Business and Leasing Business segments. The company provides banking services, credit guarantee, consumer finance, credit card services, debt collection management services, system development, and operation management services. It also provides investment advisory services, consulting and administrative outsourcing services, and fund management services.
